'''Mateo Yolka''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th–6th (I think) at [[February 2001 Framingham tournament]] on 3 February 2001 with X-wing swarm EBO, according to Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1700">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-framingham-ma-2-3-01d1700/ framingham-ma-2-3-01], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 4 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-framingham-ma-2-3-01d1700/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
